judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: The "Próximo" button scrolls the "Novidades" product strip. I checked the live page at 1280x800. It is a native button with no tabindex. Its wrapper turns display:none once the strip reaches its end, and Tabbing through the six product links scrolls the strip there. So a forward walk skips it, and a backward walk run in that same scrolled state skips it too. After a fresh load, Shift+Tab from below does reach it (7th Shift+Tab in my test), so the claim that Tab and Shift+Tab never reach it comes from the state the walk left the strip in. Its function, showing the next products, is also available by keyboard: every product link takes focus and scrolls the strip into view. So 2.1.1 is not failed.

judgments.label: false_positive

On the live page, the only key listeners on window, document, html and body are keydown, keypress and keyup on document, all wrapped by the Sentry SDK. With focus on body, pressing "d" (and "x" and "j") changed nothing my checks caught: no scroll, no URL change, no focus move, and no DOM mutation other than the per-second countdown digits and the rotating header-advantages ticker. Those change just the same with no key pressed. The probe's 'changed what the window shows' most likely caught a timer tick, not a shortcut. No evidence of any character-key shortcut.

judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: The link "Conheça nossas coleções!" in main is the subject. At 390x844 the #contador coupon banner is position:fixed, z-index 1000, 390x170 px at y 674, and the page sets no scroll-padding. html uses scroll-behavior:smooth, so I sampled the position over 1.5 s to rule out a mid-scroll capture. In two of my three live walks the link scrolled to mid-viewport and was visible. In the third, focused at Tab 31 as in Rampa's walk, it settled at y 827 and stayed fully under the banner. A sticky banner the author placed, not one the user opened, that entirely covers the focused element is failure F110. Whether it happens depends on the scroll state, but it is a real, reachable failure.

judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: "Central de ajuda" sits inside the collapsed "Precisa de ajuda?" footer accordion at 390 px. Its container .collapsible-text has max-height:0, overflow:hidden and is 2 px tall. The link is invisible because its own collapsed container clips it, not because the static "SOBRE A CHICO REI" button covers it; that button only happens to lie under the hit-test points. Focus landing on content inside a collapsed section is a real problem, but it fails 2.4.7 Focus Visible (and arguably 2.4.3 Focus Order), not 2.4.11's obscuring by other content.
